dimensions.note: watch logs structured entry and completion events without input evidence.
Strict parsing, temporal provenance, freshness, availability, and request binding fail before the single write.

Synthetic tests cover transition grouping, chronological offset ordering, deterministic replay, truncation, stale and future-collected evidence, malformed fields and references, authority, persistence, and request binding.
Pure analysis is deterministic and the request-bound instance name makes replay overwrite the same logical resource.
Documentation and fixtures contain synthetic identifiers only.
Argument, input, output, source-reference, and all nested object schemas are strict; malformed unknown fields are tested.
The sole watch resource declares infinite lifetime and retention of ten versions.
This is a decision-only analyzer, not a CRUD lifecycle model.
No provider or factory mutation is exposed.
The sole write uses a validated requestId bound exactly to watchId.
